commits.author: Lohrr
commits.message: Made kneeling less extra damage than sitting.  Put the POS_\* in order such that POS_PRONE == 0 = least and POS_STANDING = 3 = most.  This should be easier to modify should we add more positions now, but I don't think that'll ever be necessary.  Also, flank or circle damage no longer supercedes kneeling or reclinging bonus damage. commits.author: Lohrr
commits.message: New link flags created: REMOVE_AFF and SHOW_REMOVE_MSG.  These flags allow you to remove the associated affect when the link is broken and to show the remove-message for said affect.  A new generic link 'LNK_CHAR_OBJ_AFF' was created to utilize both of these flags.  The unequip_char function now takes an additional bool saving that tells it whether or not we're just saving so don't break links (this boolean defaults to FALSE).  The char-object links now display the associated affect (or 'no affect' if there is none) when doing a 'stat char <name>'.  The cegilunes_broken function no longer removes the affect since it's done through the LNKFLG_REMOVE_AFF flag (this caused a crash when the affect was removed a second time).  The crown of Aramus now utilizes the REMOVE_AFF and SHOW_REMOVE_MSG options instead of just casting the spell so unequipping the crown now removes all the spells it cast on the char.  Also, the crown only works if worn head.. not held anymore.

commits.author: Lohrr
commits.message: Fix to counting PCs in game: made variables in actinf.c constant since they're only being reported via world stat.  Players loaded by immortals now count (so don't go loading a bunch of chars to throw off numbers).  Added a ends_with( char *a, char *b ) function that checks for b being a suffix of a, and tested it in the testcmd.c's do_test function (command: test suffix stringa stringb).  Note: test command doesn't handle spaces in the strings but the actual function does.  I then used ends_with to identify locker characters and not have them decrement the number of ingame pcs when someone leaves their locker (they never incremented it).  Also, made is_abbrev return a boolean instead of integer since that's more accurate.
